SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-28-2020 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF NICHOLE XIOMARA TUPAS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT AIRBNB HQ, REPRESENTED BY VESLA LEE IS PRESENT BY COURTCALL. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. DEFENDANT STATES THAT SHE HAS ALL THE COMMUNICATIONS BETWEEN PLAINTIFF, DEFENDANT AND THE HOST PROPERTY THAT WERE PRESENTED FOR REVIEW BY COURT. COMMISSIONER PANG LY; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
